thread:
maria.g: Heads up — critical security patch for the tokenizer lib, needs prod deploy ASAP within today's change window. Gatekeeper currently blocks because deployer role expired. Anyone oncall can approve short-lived exemption?
sam.k: I can approve but need MFA prompt — current SSO push is failing for me. Re-enrolling now.
deploy-bot: Permission check failed: user not in deployer group. See https://internal/ops/perm-check. To request JIT, run:
```
/rise-jit --role deployer --duration 1h --reason "sec-patch"
```
zach.h: We shouldn't grant broad exemptions. Can we do a one-off signed release: pin version to 2.3.7-hotfix and run a canary then full? That reduces blast radius.
carla.p: :thumbsup: pin + canary sounds good. Need two approvers for production per policy. Maria, can you get the second approver? @oncall-sre can you review logs during canary?
oncall-sre: I'll watch the canary. Also: audit log requires justification recorded. Please paste the JIT ticket ID.
maria.g: I created JIT ticket 4629. Added justification and linked PR #1289. Sam — can you approve once MFA is sorted? If not, we need an alternate approver.
sam.k: MFA still flaky. I'll escalate to identity. If no fix in 20m, @zach.h can you approve? I trust you on this.
zach.h: I can approve. I'll validate test-run outputs. Approving now: `approved: zach.h`
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: JIT granted to zach.h for 1h, ticket 4629. Initiating canary deploy to pool-prod-canary-1. Rolling: version=2.3.7-hotfix, shard=1/3.
maria.g: Canary started. Observability dashboard: https://artifacts/obs/canary/4629. @oncall-sre pls confirm no SLO regressions.
oncall-sre: Watching. No latency or error spikes at +5m. Will monitor for 15 more minutes.
sam.k: :phew: MFA fixed. Thanks team. I'll follow up with identity on root cause and file a support ticket.
carla.p: Once canary green, roll full. Add post-deploy note: 'hotfix: tokenizer memory leak patch; rolled to prod via JIT with two approvers; ticket 4629'.
maria.g: Recording in release notes and audit: done. Rolling to full now.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Full rollout in progress. Rollout complete to 3/3. version=2.3.7-hotfix. If rollback needed: run `/deploy rollback --to 2.3.6`
oncall-sre: All good. No regressions after 30m. Closing ticket 4629. Filing postmortem on MFA blip later.
